verdict.rationale: The README documents one-line install commands (`npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills`, a single-skill `--skill` variant, and an all-agents non-interactive path), so a fast path to an installed skill exists. Nothing evidences a structured quickstart, a check that the skill works after install, or the under-five-minute claim. Missing for 10: dedicated quickstart guide, post-install verification step showing a working skill, time-to-success evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from nothing to a working installed skill in under five minutes

citations.quote: Install interactively with the open `skills` CLI: npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills
Install one skill by user-intent-first name: npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills --skill wiki-yylo
Install all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts
